picks.title: Unity unveils Unity 7 roadmap at Unite Seoul
picks.excerpt: Unity revealed its Unity 7 roadmap at Unite Seoul: same Unity 6 architecture with zero-rebuild upgrades, AI-assisted graphics optimization and integration with the Unity Vector AI engine. Unity says the release is 'built for a future where humans and coding agents can work together,' while promising studios that keep AI out of creative work aren't sidelined.
picks.rationale: Major engine roadmap from a top-tier source that bakes AI-assisted optimization and coding agents into Unity 7 with a no-rebuild upgrade path — directly changes how game teams plan tomorrow.

picks.title: NVIDIA reveals the controls devs actually have for DLSS 5's AI filter
picks.excerpt: PC Gamer breaks down the two main sliders NVIDIA is giving developers to steer the DLSS 5 AI filter, after concerns that the neural renderer removes artistic control over the final image. More dev-facing controls are reportedly being built.
picks.rationale: Concrete, credible detail on the exact controls artists get over DLSS 5's neural render — actionable for tech artists worried about losing creative say over the final frame. Distinct accent from the other games picks.

picks.title: Meshy wants AI to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
picks.excerpt: Meshy launched a 3D Agent Beta, a conversational AI that keeps context across steps so game artists can brainstorm, generate stylistically consistent asset collections and iterate — positioning AI as a creative partner rather than a one-shot prompt. Assets export to Blender, Unreal Engine and Unity pipelines.
picks.rationale: Fresh tool release (3D Agent Beta) that shifts 3D asset generation from one-shot prompts to iterative, context-aware collaboration exporting straight into Blender/Unreal/Unity — immediately useful for game artists. Distinct accent from the other games picks.
